{{short description|Result on the p-parts of the Galois eigenspaces of an ideal class group}}
In [[algebraic number theory]], the '''Gras conjecture''' {{harv|Gras|1977}} relates the ''p''-parts of the Galois eigenspaces of an [[ideal class group]] to the group of global units modulo [[cyclotomic unit]]s. It was proved by {{harvtxt|Mazur|Wiles|1984}} as a corollary of their work on the [[main conjecture of Iwasawa theory]]. {{harvtxt|Kolyvagin|1990}} later gave a simpler proof using [[Euler system]]s. A version of the Gras conjecture applying to [[ray class groups]] was later proven by Timothy All.
